calendarPosts.title: Why 80% of Vitamin C is Destroyed in Conventional Heat Drying
calendarPosts.caption:
Conventional drying pushes air up to 90°C, stripping heat-labile ascorbic acid and delicate bioactives.

At koh!, our vacuum dehydration chamber operates under reduced atmospheric pressure at 58°C. The result? 94% retention of Vitamin C and intact cellular enzymes.

Transparency is our only preservative. Swipe to read our lab assays on Wild Amla.

calendarPosts.title: Direct from farm gate to dehydration in Suryapet: How we solved cold-chain spoilage

In India, post-harvest fruit and vegetable loss exceeds 25% due to inadequate rural cold chain.

By placing our dehydration hubs within 40km of farmer plots, we lock in freshness within 4 hours of harvest. Here is the operational blueprint.
